posts.body:
WaW a Cave!
​
SECTION A: SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
This is a short game
(my second game completed)
, literally made with just 3 maps, where the player takes on the role of a Flag Bearer who made the pact with the Red Wing in the Wings at War lore. You’ll fight using an action battle system and solve challenges to complete the game. Inspired by games like Ragnarok Online and Skyrim.
